scope: Preflight full or unresolved combined report journals before changing submission state

reproduction.finding: A valid restored v8 snapshot with 1000 SDK-confirmed historical entries acquired the writer, marked beginTriage uncertain, then rejected the journal before any SDK call. The UI incorrectly rendered Transaction outcome unknown.

change: A shared reportJournalBlockReason distinguishes unresolved history from capacity; MAX_REPORT_ATTEMPTS also supplies the recovery validator limit.
App beginAction checks the journal before acquiring busy state, preparing/uploading a new report or marking a transition uncertain.
The transaction helper retains a second guard that releases persistence without saving, stopping the writer, installing a checkpoint, changing journal entries or invoking SDK work.
Existing unknown markers are not cleared automatically; the 1000-entry bound and recovery v8 format remain unchanged.

runs.remainingFailure: New UI assertion expected one copy of the limit message, which is rendered in two operation notices. Both other files passed.

runs.scope: Corrected duplicate-message locator and exercised real encrypted restore/activation with mocked wallet/ledger, capacity refusal, retained writer, no new uncertainty and no ciphertext upload.

boundaryCoverage: 999 confirmed entries accept and persist the 1000th while preserving prior history.
Full and unresolved journals do not install a checkpoint or invoke save/prepare/submit.

limits: No new full regression, browser E2E, native wallet ceremony or container refresh.
This does not add journal archival/rotation or permit another transaction after the journal reaches capacity.
Previously saved uncertainty is still retained; this is not transaction reconciliation or retry authorization.
